page_title: JUV 2-0 BOL | Juventus v Bologna 19/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' A pass by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Juventus are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
87' Handball! A player from Juventus handled the ball.
87' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
86' Juventus players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
86' Substitution. Lois Openda (Juventus) on for Jeremie Boga.
84' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' Nikola Moro (Bologna) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
80' Luciano Spalletti prepares a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is replaced by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
78' Some great controlled play and passing from Bologna. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
77' Here's the change. Santiago Castro leaves the pitch and Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
74' A pass from Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is intercepted by Federico Ravaglia and the move breaks down.
72' Luciano Spalletti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) replacing Francisco Conceicao.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) replaces Jonathan David.
71' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
69' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends it out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
68' Eivind Fauske Helland just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) replaces him.
67' The game is interrupted now, Eivind Fauske Helland (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' Juventus keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
63' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
61' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
59' A substitution has been made. Nicolo Cambiaghi is replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna).
59' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Simon Sohm.
58' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Tommaso Pobega will be replaced by Nikola Moro (Bologna).

57' 2 - 0 Weston McKennie sends a superb cross into the box. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Federico Ravaglia beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:0.
56' It looks like Weston McKennie (Juventus) saw red with that tackle. Maurizio Mariani won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
55' Jonathan David (Juventus) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
53' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) tries to find Jeremie Boga, but he puts too much power on the pass.
52' Bologna take the free kick with a short pass.
51' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Maurizio Mariani saw the whole situation.
47' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
47' Some neat passing and movement from Bologna as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
46' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Emil Holm comes off for Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Maurizio Mariani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

43' Fine attempt! Jonathan David (Juventus) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
42' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
41' Jeremie Boga (Juventus) forces a pass into the box, but Federico Ravaglia is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
36' The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
34' Emil Holm (Juventus) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the crossbar!
32' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) sends an accurate short pass. Francisco Conceicao controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
30' A pass by Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
25' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
25' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
23' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
22' Chance! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
20' Jonathan David (Juventus) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
19' Jonathan David almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

14' What a poor attempt! Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
13' Bologna string together a series of short passes.
12' A goal, which was scored by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), was disallowed due to offside.
9' Federico Ravaglia displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jonathan David (Juventus) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
8' The ball is cleared after Remo Freuler (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Jonathan David (Juventus) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
6' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Some patient build-up play from Juventus as they look to unlock the defence.

2' 1 - 0 Pierre Kalulu produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Jonathan David (Juventus) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
1' Juventus take a short corner kick.

1' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Maurizio Mariani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
